shared_elements: rows of repeated small units (glyph blocks / curl motifs)
justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces carry ordered, repeated small carved units arranged in horizontal registers " in A blocks of script-like signs, in B rows of tightly spiralled hair curls and vertical fluting on a headdress. A depicts no figures at all, only an inscribed field, whereas B is a naturalistic human head in profile with eye, ear, nose, beard and crown, so the subject matter is essentially unrelated.
